Explore content ranked by demand, freshness and QA results.

What drives the score

Public, published items with both view periods; reviewed tests stay in Admin.

Base: annual views 45%, 90-day views 35%, freshness 20%. Views are compared within each content type.

With usable QA: 75% base + 25% content hygiene (100 minus the P2/P3 error score); P1 stays in urgent action.

Unknown inputs are omitted and weights rebalance. Without usable completed QA, the base score stands. QA measures reported content hygiene; it does not establish relevance, obsolescence or complete quality. Open a row for evidence.
